rows.reason: An unanchored timestamp cannot prove that no retarget occurred during a physical interval.

rows.included: Projected edge count, base-matrix support size, contributing width, certificate clearance and SCC sizes for complete accepted epochs.
rows.name: amend:testing:standing-work-structure
rows.reason: Only supplied complete inputs determine these structural quantities.

rows.excluded: Truth and completeness of execution measurements, including map passes and cache behaviour.
rows.included: Presence and declared scope of map-pass, residual-target, cache-invalidation and elapsed-time measurements.
rows.name: amend:testing:standing-work-execution
rows.reason: A retained residual certificate can be checked separately, but it does not attest how the run obtained it.

rows.excluded: Representativeness, hardware truth and measured runtime envelopes.
rows.included: Presence of the percentile, scale, duration, hardware, arithmetic, memory and workload declarations and arithmetic over supplied samples.
rows.name: amend:testing:standing-work-envelopes
rows.reason: Recomputing a percentile does not validate acquisition or an omitted population.

rows.excluded: Truth of that measured limiting load.
rows.included: Publication of the asserted load at which the duration target is missed.
rows.name: amend:testing:standing-work-limiting-load
rows.reason: The record contains an assertion about the machine, not an independent machine observation.

rows.excluded: Performance of review and application on unobserved triggers.
rows.included: Presence of the threshold and timeout/fallback policy and consistency of supplied trigger records.
rows.name: amend:testing:standing-work-review
rows.reason: Publishing a process does not prove that it was carried out.

rows.excluded: Whether an unpublished trial dropped relations or substituted approximate standing.
rows.included: No relation is dropped and no approximate standing is substituted in a complete published accepted epoch.
rows.name: amend:testing:standing-work-complete-projection
rows.reason: A complete accepted package permits the check; unpublished trials do not supply the inputs to it.

rows.name: amend:testing:standing-work-frontier
rows.reason: This sentence explains the purpose of measurement evidence for the evaluation frontier; it imposes no additional duty.

rows.excluded: Using certificate-only verification as fulfillment of that same-procedure clause before a published amendment admits that route.
rows.included: The same-procedure clause is claimed through exact reproduction of the declared build and fresh-request discipline.
rows.name: amend:testing:canonical-replay-verification
rows.reason: The clause requires equal replay verdicts; a checked straddle establishes a sound enclosure but does not require another build to remain indecisive, so the alternative route needs amended text.
